concerns_addressed: Abort plumbing in scanFolder, scanAll, and raceDeadline correctly propagates AbortSignal cancellation.
Third 'aborted' promise in Promise.race handles signal abortion.
Abort listener is registered with { once: true } and explicitly removed in raceDeadline's finally block.
Unresolved 'aborted' promise when no signal is present is harmless local scope cleanup; no memory leak or resource pin.

strengths: Per-request AbortController correctly tied to response 'close' event with cleanup in finally block.
flushHeaders() called prior to streaming event-stream payloads.
event: done and res.end() executed only when scan completes successfully without abort.
Non-regression verified: scanAll and GET /api/scan behave identically when abortSignal and onProgress are omitted.

Comprehensive test coverage asserting content-type, folder event frames, terminal done event parsing, single readdir work on client disconnect, absence of done after destroy, no uncaught exceptions, and continued server health.
stage_2.assessment: The implementation of the SSE scan streaming endpoint (commit 3822cb0dfeceacd8533cf353d13909a4fe2df1b6) is clean, robust, and well-tested. All abort plumbing, listener cleanup, response state guards, and streaming headers are correctly implemented without regressions or resource leaks.
